manifest.head: 681e34df0cff29a0bd4b0cadf60627fceb8af9c5
manifest.note: Private full mixed workload. Exact full BE state, selected deterministic entity fields, conservation and gameTick counters; external JMX native ring inner-active timing. No instrumentation mod or new admission.

steady.methodology: Independent JVM rounds remain separate; inner-active native ticks, external JMX allocation/CPU/GC, exact full-window work/state. All complete paired receipts required; no dropped tails. No claim about arbitrary callback or admitted BE classes.
